name: BIRLA
source:
The protagonist is a genetically altered and artificially created human being on a planet different from Earth. One day, the research facility she resides in is attacked and she is easily kidnapped.
The blue sky, the dancing flowers, and the rolling sea. Everything she dreamed of in her cage does not exist in the outside world.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29077]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主角是一名经过基因改造、人工制造的地球外人类。一天，她所在的研究设施遭到袭击，自己也轻易地被人掳走。
蓝天、摇曳的花朵、翻涌的海洋——这些她在牢笼中梦见的一切，在外面的世界里都不存在。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29077]Freem![/url]]
